Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.contacts

Class Contact

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.contacts.Contact
public class Contact extends Object
One entry of the desktop-wide address book.

This is the single, shared contact model every desktop application reads and writes: the production Contacts app (lg3d-apps), the Agenda attendee picker (lg3d-incubator) and the Messenger / Video Conference address books (lg3d-apps). It lives in lg3d-core because that is the only module all of those consumers already depend on, so the address book needs no new inter-module dependency and no reflective hand-off.

A contact carries only identity the user entered — there is deliberately no seeded or demo data anywhere in the address book. Multi-valued fields (e-mails, phones, tags) are plain lists; the first element is the "primary" one by convention. Passwords or other secrets must never be stored here.
